title: Srinivasa Ramanujan Complex
text: Srinivasa Ramanujan Complex is an academic complex with academic buildings like Takshashila, Vikramshila and Sir J C Bose Laboratory Complex. The open area behind the Vikramshila also serves as the arena for Kshitij. It also has some eateries inside the complex including Rao canteen.

Srinivasa Ramanujan Complex
